images.title: 新建项目 · 工作安排
images.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Asset type: high fidelity desktop application screenshot for Agent Hub v1 product design review, not a marketing page, not a diagram. Create a single 16:10 desktop viewport at high resolution (1920x1200 target). Use the attached reference ONLY for the visual design system: elegant white content, very light cool gray navigation, restrained blue #245BDB accents, dark slate Chinese typography, thin separators, deliberate spacing, no large decorative cards or gradients. Improve craft and hierarchy while preserving that established visual language.
MANDATORY persistent left rail: app icon, then exact Chinese labels 项目 / 成果 / 待我决定 / 知识库 / 成员; settings and avatar at bottom. This rail is about 78 px, project or contextual list is about 220 px, remaining screen broad for content. Realistic Chinese macOS desktop web UI with typography at readable relative sizes: body16, UI14, helper12. Text must be sharp and carefully composed. Small full-width top strip reads exactly “Agent Hub v1 · 原型效果图 · 示例数据，未连接真实 Agent”. All business data are illustrative. No token prices, no ETA claims, no invented live connection proof, no model training claim, no dashboards, no role assignments, no API configuration pasted in chat. All text Chinese except product names Grok and Dot. One screen only, no montage, no device frame, no perspective.
Scene: New project step 2 “工作安排”, matching product plan4.2 and4.3. Main white panel, no full-screen modal. Three small step indicators top: 1 说目标 (complete), 2 工作安排 (selected), 3 定节奏. Breadcrumb 新建项目 / 工作安排. Heading “一次交代，让团队接着做”; smaller one-line user goal “研究智能戒指，有哪些适合个人开发者的产品机会？” with 编辑目标 text link. A calm aligned form, not enormous cards:
Row 交付形式 two compact segmented radio options “一份最终结果” selected in blue, “各自提交，并排对比” unselected. Helper “只看最终成果；中间的交接和修订由团队完成。”
Row 怎么做 three stacked concise radio rows: “各自研究，再由一位汇总” selected, “一位做，另一位检查”, “一位直接完成”.
Row 参与成员 two checkbox chips: Grok with dark G avatar, Dot with teal D avatar; both checked. No Muse selected. Each tiny tag “示例成员”.
Row 汇总成员 drop-down Dot.
Row 合格标准 three editable check rows “结论附原始出处”“明确支持二开的条件”“未确认的信息标出缺口” and “+ 添加标准”.
Very subtle gray caption “按目标类型给出的默认安排，可以修改”.
Bottom restrained secondary button “让团队安排” with small “额外叫醒 Dot 一次，费用以平台为准”; right side navigation buttons “上一步” and blue “下一步：定节奏”. Include a plain side preview explaining “你将收到 / 一份可编辑的研究备忘录” with 3 concise sample sections “产品机会 / 可行路径 / 待你取舍”. Don't insert a second 开始 button; actual execution is step3.

Scene: Wide final result review screen, product plan4.5 and4.6. Selected left rail 项目. Contextual left column says “← 返回群聊”, project “智能戒指机会研究”, small “成果 1”, just ONE selected document “智能戒指：先做哪种产品？”, and bottom “资料与规则”. No pile of separate agent intermediate drafts.
Main document area occupies at least70% of the main panel's height with wide elegant typography. Top thin toolbar: document icon “工作稿”, “版本 3 ▾”, right “出处”, copy icon, download icon, “已保存”. Below tiny provenance “Dot 汇总 · Grok、Dot 参与 · 示例”.
Document h1 “智能戒指：先做哪种产品？”; small muted one-line “本轮记录：独有发现 2 · 多处引用 3 · 待你决定 1   查看依据” with subtle “示例”.
Lead paragraph “优先验证用户愿意反复使用的场景，再决定硬件与数据路线。”
Section “先把‘支持二开’查清楚” paragraph “能连接蓝牙，不代表开放原始数据。选择前需要确认 SDK、数据权限和分发条件。” tiny source ref[1][2] links not fabricated named manufacturers.
Section “把两条可行路径放在一起” then an inline amber #FFF8EB bordered decision block width matching paragraph: title “待你决定：先快速验证，还是掌握原始数据？” two balanced columns each actual member avatar/name, 3 concise lines:
Grok “现成 SDK，快速做 Demo” / “先验证场景与使用意愿” / “数据能力受现成接口约束” / source link “查看依据[1]” / button “采纳此方案”.
Dot “开放原始数据，自行开发” / “保留算法和产品控制权” / “开发投入更高” / source link “查看依据[2]” / button “采纳此方案”.
Footer in amber card “汇总建议：先验证场景，再扩大投入。” with “两种都保留”“我自己写”, unchecked “同类问题以后都这样选”.
Bottom fixed compact action bar “采用”“弃用”“让 Dot 改”. No huge right sidebar by default. Small unobtrusive gray page-edge note beside a paragraph “从你的修改里总结：只选官方明确支持二开的方案” with default scope “本项目 ▾”, actions “以后都这样 / 只这次 / 改措辞”, visibly labelled “示例建议”. Keep the note in narrow page margin, not over the document. User can edit the main text.

Scene: Alternative user-selected delivery mode, not revision-history comparison. Selected rail 成果. Contextual side column contains project “智能戒指机会研究”, small label “交付形式”, selected “各自提交，并排对比”. Main header “不同的答案，放在一起看”; subtitle “成员独立完成，未进行汇总 · 示例内容”. Top right understated buttons “查看安排”“导出”.
Two equal-width side-by-side paper columns with aligned sections, restrained borders, no gigantic cards. Column1 black G avatar Grok, label “独立交付 A”；Column2 teal D avatar Dot “独立交付 B”. Both have matched section headings “01 产品切入点”, “02 实现路径”, “03 风险与缺口”.
First two columns content about smart ring scenario: Grok recommends “先做已有 SDK 上的场景 Demo”，lists “验证用户是否愿意每天使用；通过 SDK 获取已开放指标；确认数据使用和分发权限”；Dot recommends “围绕数据开放程度选择硬件”，lists “明确需要哪些原始数据；核查采样、导出和授权能力；把开发成本与控制权一起比较”. Each paragraph ends source reference [1] or[2] and compact text action “采用这段”.
One paragraph in leftcolumn lightly blue highlighted with “已加入工作稿” after hypothetical adoption. Keep this an illustrative screen.
Below the two aligned columns, visible separate full-width editor region with title “我的工作稿”, small “已采用 1 段 · 可继续编辑”, body “先用现成 SDK 验证场景，同时保留原始数据能力的选型清单。” At least a quarter of viewport shows this editor, not hidden below bottom edge. Do not automatically choose a winner, no percentage score, no consolidated fake consensus. Toolbar labels “保存工作稿”“继续编辑”.

Scene: Knowledge library rule view, product plan4.10 and5.7. Left rail selected 知识库. No project column here; broad white workspace with main title “把这次的修改，留给下一次”. Small subtitle “规则有范围，使用有记录，随时可以改变主意。” Below two horizontal tabs “规则” selected, “资料”; right “+ 添加规则”. Search input “搜索规则或来源”, compact filters “全部项目 ▾”“全部状态 ▾”.
Main is an elegant compact table, not a card wall. Columns 规则 / 范围 / 来源 / 状态 / 最近一次使用 / 操作.
A small highlighted first expanded row labelled “待确认”, rule “只收录官方明确支持二开的方案”, scope dropdown “本项目”, source “来自《智能戒指机会研究》的修改”, expanded plain text and three clear actions “以后都这样”“只这次”“改措辞”. It is pending, not active.
Second regular row “引用旧价格时，重新核查来源” / “本项目” / “来自你的决定” / “生效中” / “已用于 2 轮 · 本轮已带入” / “修订 · 撤回”.
Third row “缺少原始资料时明确写出缺口” / “全部项目” / “手动添加” / “生效中” / “审阅记录 · 结果已符合” / “修订 · 撤回”.
Fourth row “统一使用一段式结论” / “本项目” / “来自历史修改” / “已撤回” / “历史记录” / “查看”.
Right narrow details panel selected second rule, titled “本次使用记录”, displays three distinct status entries with precise copy: “本轮已带入” with “任务派发时带入规则版本2”; “结果已符合” with “由 Dot 审阅，对应正文第2节 · 示例”; “未确认 / 发现偏离” with “未检查时保留此状态”. Do not imply a checked icon guarantees truth.
Bottom contextual strip “继续使用已有成果” plus mini recent artifact row “智能戒指机会研究 · 工作稿版本3 · 示例” and a text button “用于新任务”. This is reuse navigation, not a new agent score dashboard. Footer small “来源、范围和每次修订均可回查”. Use restrained blue and gray, amber only actual pending decision/confirmations. No model training claim.
